verdict.rationale: Cactus documents that any Hugging Face model can be converted with `cactus convert [HF-Name]` and run locally via `cactus run`, but the vendor itself labels this path experimental. A hands-on report says GGUF models (Jan Nano, SmolLM3) downloaded fine in the demo app but crashed on selection, and another notes models download inline at runtime with no separate cache API. Missing for 10: a stable, non-experimental HF download/convert path, documented supported model families, a separate download/cache API, and independent confirmation that arbitrary HF models run reliably.
